game: GB @ NYG, 2025-11-16 13:00 ET, outdoors, NYG +7.5, total 41.5

script.base: GB -7.5 (implied 24.5) leads by halftime in a 41.5-point outdoor game and finishes on the ground with Josh Jacobs, who already has 51 carries and 194 yards in weeks 8-10. NYG, with Jaxson Dart out, lives near its 17.0 implied total: Tyrone Tracy (29/128 L3) is the back who has actually played, and a trailing script plus GB's 3.86 YPC run defense pushes the Giants toward short throws (Wan'Dale Robinson 26 targets, Theo Johnson 18/122) rather than a Cam Skattebo workload.
script.flip1: The game stays competitive because GB is missing CB Nate Hobbs and S Tyler Nubin is doubtful, and GB's middle YPA allowed is 7.21. Love keeps throwing (he is better vs the blitz, 0.31 EPA/db vs 0.23 clean), Jacobs's carries stall under 74.5, and NYG slot/TE volume is the live path.
script.flip2: GB blows it open early against a Giants front missing Kayvon Thibodeaux, Chauncey Golston and, if he sits, Rakeem Nunez-Roches. Love and the WRs stall after halftime while Jacobs's carries rise; NYG garbage-time throws can still feed Robinson/Johnson, but Skattebo does not suddenly become a 60-yard back.

injury_fallout: Pre-game injury report only; inactives ~90 minutes out are not in the pack. NYG QB Jaxson Dart Out (concussion) erases the weeks 8-10 rushing QB (19 car/140 yds) and the starter; pack does not name the backup. WR Darius Slayton Out (hamstring) removes 16 targets/177 yards/232 air yards from that same window; next men already producing are Robinson (26 targets/156) and Theo Johnson (18/122). Malik Nabers is not listed out but has only a 4-game log (last4 recyds 71, 167, 13, 20), so his share of Slayton's targets is unknown. Edge/DL fallout favors GB's run: Thibodeaux Out, Golston Out, Nunez-Roches Doubtful. Also out/doubtful: G Evan Neal, S Tyler Nubin Doubtful, LB Bobby Okereke Questionable, CB Paulson Adebo Questionable. GB: CB Nate Hobbs Out helps NYG receivers; WR Matthew Golden Questionable (shoulder) and WR Savion Williams Questionable are game-time; DE Lukas Van Ness Questionable; K Brandon McManus Doubtful is irrelevant to these markets. Jacobs, Wilson, Kraft, Doubs, Tracy, Skattebo, Robinson and Johnson are not listed out.

matchup.shell: No MOFO/MOFC or man/zone charting in the pack. Location proxy only: NYG allows middle 8.82 YPA (68 att) vs left 6.52 (126) and right 6.49 (160). GB allows middle 7.21 YPA (82) vs left 5.64 (109) and right 5.46 (125). Both defenses bleed the middle more than the perimeter.
matchup.pressure: NYG blitz rate 30%; Jordan Love EPA/db is 0.31 vs blitz and 0.23 vs no blitz, so NYG pressure does not suppress GB and is a weak reason to fade GB deep shots or force checkdowns. GB blitz rate 24%; NYG EPA/db is -0.09 vs blitz and +0.06 clean, so pressure hurts whoever starts for NYG with Dart out. Thibodeaux and Golston out further lowers NYG's pass-rush threat.
matchup.bleeds: NYG run defense: 5.88 YPC and 48 runs of 10+ over 10 games, plus 29 passes of 20+ for 375 yards. GB run defense: 3.86 YPC and only 15 runs of 10+ over 9 games, plus 17 passes of 20+ for 338 yards. GB is the stingy run unit; NYG is the unit that gives up explosive runs.
matchup.overlap: Chosen overlap is Jacobs, the GB lead back (51 of the RB carries in weeks 8-10), into NYG's 5.88 YPC run defense and a front missing Thibodeaux, Golston and likely Nunez-Roches. The pass overlap (Kraft/Johnson/Robinson into middle YPA) is real but not the two legs: Kraft's 143-yard game looks fluky, Doubs has 267 air yards and only 140 receiving yards L3, and Dart's absence caps NYG pass efficiency on a 17.0 team total.

form: Avoiding season averages. Jacobs last4 rush yards 55, 33, 87, 74 — only 87 clears 74.5 — and L3 is 51/194 (3.80 YPC, about 64.7 a game) with 14 targets/58 rec yards. Wilson is the change-of-pace (18/79 L3; last4 rush 17, 61, 16, 2), one spike not a takeover. Kraft last4 rec 43, 58, 143, 20; Doubs last4 72, 44, 91, 5; Golden last4 86, 37, 4, 9 and Questionable. Skattebo's current role is gone: L3 is 3 carries/12 yards, while last4 rush 59, 98, 60, 12 shows the old featured-back median the 59.5 stand-in is built on. Tracy is the NYG back who has played (L3 29/128; last4 rush 46, 39, 18, 71; rec last4 0, 14, 19, 0). Robinson last4 rec 95, 48, 46, 62. Johnson last4 66, 20, 27, 75 on L3 18 targets/122 yards. Nabers last4 71, 167, 13, 20 on four games only.

pre_mortem: Monday Jacobs lost because the 3.80 YPC traveled: NYG sold out to stop the run, Wilson took a 61-style chunk, or Love attacked 8.82 middle YPA with Hobbs and Nubin missing and Thibodeaux out, so GB passed and Jacobs finished 33-55 again. He has cleared 74.5 once in the last four. Skattebo lost if the three-week benching was temporary and the staff gave him Dart's vacated runs in a one-score game, posting another 60-98 yard day; the pack has no beat writer confirming the demotion is permanent, and 59.5 is exactly his old featured-game median. That counter is real but weaker than three straight weeks of 3 total carries with Tracy clearly ahead, so the under stays.
